goal: Review the 386accc..HEAD diff for actionable defects in the run artifact contract: manifest, decision, report, summary, verify, scope, workorder, and researchcmd changes. Report only actionable findings with file:line evidence. Do not implement code.
background: Base ref: 386accc. Review ref: HEAD (working diff generated via --base 386accc --diff --changed-files).
Lens: artifact-contract. Focus on the durable artifact shape and schema contract for single-provider and pairwise runs.

Primary changed files: internal/manifest/manifest.go, internal/decision/decision.go, internal/report/report.go, internal/verify/verify.go, internal/scope/scope.go, internal/workorder/workorder.go, internal/repocontext/repocontext.go, internal/commands/researchcmd/run.go.

Contract concerns: schema_version stability, experiment metadata (id/task_id/run_kind/repetition_index/condition_id/slot_id/slot_attempt) persistence into manifest/decision, single-provider semantics (no winner / no majority vote), decision.json field consistency, and verifier output JSON contract.
Acceptance criteria: every finding must cite a concrete file:line in the diff and describe an observable contract break, inconsistency, or missing field rather than style.
Known risk areas: single-provider artifact-contract hardening and experiment-metadata hardening landed together; check for fields that are written but never validated, or validated but never written.

facet.focus: Find actionable defects in the run artifact contract introduced or exposed by the diff: manifest, decision, report, verify, scope, and workorder shape and field consistency.
include: missing, mistyped, or never-populated fields in manifest.go, decision.go, or report.go
experiment metadata that is accepted but not persisted into durable artifacts
single-provider artifact shape that incorrectly implies a winner or majority vote
verifier output JSON contract mismatches in verify.go
schema_version or run_kind handling that breaks backward compatibility
scope or repocontext changes that alter the recorded artifact contract
exclude: test-only files (*_test.go) which are covered by a separate lens
documentation files which are covered by a separate lens
style-only preferences without project convention evidence
